name.en: BDC Capital Life Sciences Venture Fund

strategy.thesis: Provides patient capital to seed and Series A Canadian companies developing biotechnology-based Therapeutic Products and Medical Technologies (medical devices, diagnostic tools, imaging, surgical robotics).

summary.en: A $150M fund launched by BDC Capital, Canada's Crown-corporation venture platform, dedicated to seed and Series A biotech and medtech companies.

sources.title: Life Sciences Venture Fund
sources.quote: The fund focuses on Therapeutic Products (biotechnology-based innovations) and Medical Technologies (medical devices, diagnostic tools, imaging technologies, surgical robotics).

summary.en: Montreal-founded (2018) venture capital firm investing seed through Series B in precision medicine and next-generation medical technology, with offices in Montreal, Toronto and Vancouver.

strategy.thesis: Healthcare-dedicated VC providing post-seed and Series A capital to AI-enabled MedTech and Digital Health companies in North America.

summary.en: Toronto-based, healthcare-dedicated venture capital firm founded by Sam Ifergan that closed a CAD $100M Fund I in 2018 and makes post-seed/Series A investments of $1–5M in AI-enabled MedTech and digital health companies.

strategy.thesis: Dedicated early-stage life sciences seed fund, created with the University of Toronto and McMaster University, to translate university-based biomedical research into venture-backed companies addressing critical health challenges.

summary.en: Toronto life-sciences VC (founded 2000) that in 2026 launched the Genesys University Seed Fund with the University of Toronto, McMaster University, Venture Ontario and RBC to fund early-stage biomedical spinouts.

strategy.thesis: Canada's digital-health-dedicated micro-VC, investing early in technology companies transforming care delivery across the U.S. and Canada.

summary.en: Montreal/Toronto digital-health micro-VC formed in 2019 by the founders of Medisys Health Group and Persistence Capital Partners; closed an oversubscribed $21M+ CAD inaugural fund investing $500K–$5M in early-stage healthtech.

strategy.thesis: Pan-Canadian life-science venture-creation organization that invests pre-seed capital alongside industrial R&D, IP and business-development expertise to turn differentiated Canadian science into venture-fundable companies.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operates 200,000+ sq ft of turnkey wet-lab facilities and an accelerator/executive-training program across Montreal, Vancouver and Toronto.

summary.en: Pan-Canadian life-science venture-creation organization (formed 2019, incorporating the former CDRD and Centre for Drug Research and Development networks) that has helped create 39 companies with $2.5B in follow-on risk capital raised.

strategy.thesis: Generalist Toronto seed-stage B2B tech investor with a recurring healthcare vertical, backing genomic health-record software (PhenoTips), AI-driven medical-record processing (Wisedocs) and AI drug discovery (Cyclica, acquired).

summary.en: Toronto seed-stage generalist VC (founded 2015, six funds, largest CDN$23.5M) with a consistent healthcare-software track record spanning genomic health records, medical-record AI, and AI drug discovery.

aka: Quebec Consortium for Industrial Research and Innovation in Medical Technology

check_size.raw: Target companies raising $1 million to $10 million

strategy.thesis: Quebec-based health-technology innovation consortium that blends dilutive grants, equity investment through its MEDTEQ Invest fund, and clinical/commercial support to advance pre-seed, seed and Series A Canadian health-tech SMEs.

summary.en: Montreal-based health-technology innovation consortium (NCE-CECR network) whose MEDTEQ Invest fund has deployed over $124M CAD across 24+ Canadian health-tech SMEs, combining equity, grants and clinical/commercial expertise for pre-seed through Series A companies.
summary.local: Consortium québécois de recherche et d'innovation industrielle en technologies médicales, dont le fonds MEDTEQ Invest finance des PME canadiennes de la santé en phase de démarrage.
